name: Sorcerer · Knight style B (Battle mage)
description: Eldrin redrawn as a leaner battle-sorcerer in the plumed Knight’s spirit: an old wizard with a white beard and brows, in a deep-indigo battle coat with a long back tail, a wide rakish brim on a swept-back pointed hat with a brass band, and a crimson scarf whose two long ends stream behind him the way the Knight’s plume and cape do. He leans into his stance with his casting hand held out, a flame licking on the palm; his staff, crowned with a clawed fire orb, rests slanted over his shoulder from the near hand at his hip. Fire is the one strong accent, one ramp from the scarf’s near-black red to the flame’s white core. His idle breathes (the scarf ripples, the coat tail lifts, the hat tip and beard lag a beat); on the walk the scarf and coat stream back and the flame leans away. The cast: he draws the flame in, raises it into a fireball over the brim while leaning back, then lunges and hurls it forward at the head of a blazing arc (frame 19), the ball flying on as a comet while the arc breaks into embers, and the flame rekindles in his palm. No black outline: every edge is a dark tone of its own material. The flames, the fireball, the arc and the orb glow.
